-----Original Message-----
From: 	Alves, Letícia  
Sent:	Monday, 07 October 2024 12:54
To:	Mendonça, Dom; Pires, Helena; Moraes, Sara; da Cunha, Heitor; Novaes, Antônio; Abreu, Danilo; Moraes, Camila; Azevedo, Bella; Guerra, Joaquim; Castro, Davi; Casa Grande, Clarice; Duarte, Mathias; Câmara, Carolina; Mendes, Matteo; Rocha, Brenda; Peixoto, Breno ; Castro, Thiago; Novaes, Leonardo; Montenegro, Alana; Nunes, Maria Eduarda; Pastor, João Pedro; Andrade, Diogo; das Neves, Ana Lívia ; Cavalcante, Mathias; Benicio Jr., João Gabriel; Cavalcanti, Laís; Abreu, Sarah
Subject:	BrasiLog for a Cure!



    
Well, I can't believe another year has passed, but it has.  Sunday, 27 October  is the Juvenile Diabetes Walk for a Cure! Again this year, I'm recruiting walkers for my team or simply asking for your support.  I know you hate to hear those pleading calls for more of your money, but I'm going to ask anyway - most of you know me well!  You see I have to.  As an insulin dependent diabetic myself, it is my obligation to do what I can to support every effort to find a cure for this disease which affects so many adults and children!  I know many of you see me deal with this disease everyday as I face it each time I put food in my mouth.  I follow my meals religiously with a shot of insulin along with several finger sticks a day to check my blood sugar.  It was only 4 years ago that I was diagnosed with diabetes, but your dollars are making a difference.  Within 2 years, they are expecting to be able to release insulin that can be inhaled which would eliminate the painful injections.  

I know that you have been inundated with organizations seeking your support to fund their projects and this has been especially true this year, but I hope that you will consider FundoBrasil one of the few that you continue to support as I do.  Please consider joining my team or one of the many other BrasiLog teams and help us find a cure for Diabetes!  A BrasiLog JDF t-shirt will be given to each walker or sponsor who contributes R$50,00 or more!  If R$50,00 isn't in your budget, you can purchase a "BrasiLog Badge" for only R$10,00 and it will be posted at Terminal de Carga on 25 October.  As always, your contributions are matched by BrasiLog!  Thanks for your support and I hope to see you on the 28th!

Letícia Alves
</quoted>
